_comment: Banned CONTENT in client-facing demo material, sourced from client directives.
Distinct from banned LANGUAGE (rule_anti_slop, rule_deliverables), which the
text validators already enforce. A directive that lives in a client's Planner
board or an email is invisible to the write gates until it lands here.
Adding a directive is a data change. Adding an exemption needs a reason.

terms.source: Dirk directive, Planner 'Exclude BTP from all demos': leave SAP BTP out of all demo materials
same directive, spelled out; caught on a video end card 2026-07-09

exempt.reason: Dirk's own 46-slide deck; slide 46 Technical Architecture names 'BTP, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud' as a deployment target, not a positioning claim. Removing it would make the diagram wrong. His call, not ours.
internal doc; it records the directive and quotes the banned phrasing on purpose. Not shipped to the client.
